column1: # Address files as the builder's encoder writes them (builder/src/addr_files.h). A row is of the
# kind its first field names, and its second field is what the case covers.
# blob: the record's point (lat:lng, f32 bits in hex), the footprint's logical blob and its blob
# in addr_vertices.bin, as hex. The builder's tests encode the logical blob to the blob and
# decode it back; the server's read the vertices from the blob and its test encoder
# files: the logical addr_points.bin and the logical addr_vertices.bin (- for one of no bytes),
# then addr_points.bin, addr_vertices.bin and addr_index.bin, as hex. The builder's tests encode
# the logical pair to the three files and decode them back; the server's read every record and
# its footprint from the files and its test encoder must write the same three.
